newsitem.title: USA: NYS December cash flow shows $454 mln above plan.
newsitem.headline: NYS December cash flow shows $454 mln above plan.

text.p: For the first ninth months of its fiscal year 1997, New York State's general fund balance was $454 million above the mid-year revision of the financial plan, comptroller H. Carl McCall reported Thursday.
Through December for all governmental funds, tax collections totaled $25.9 billion, a 4.4 percent increase over the same period last year.
The state's fiscal year ends March 31.

Personal income tax witholding is down 1.7 percent over the same period last year, because of tax reductions; estimated payments are up 21.1 percent; and total personal income tax collections are up 5.4 percent to $13.2 billion.
